ownerOutcome: Eva independently observes component updates, verifies candidates, installs safely, restores the last working release on proven regression, investigates failures and later reuses a reviewed fix.
scopeLimits: This is not a complete SBOM of every host OS, device firmware and browser extension.
Installed distribution does not establish that every optional library is actively used.
Official availability is not dependency resolution, behavioral compatibility or installation approval.
Npm source locks remain distinct from actual installed readback.
confirmedGaps: Hardcoded one-package-pair target and policy instead of host-trusted component descriptors.
Completed driver behavior mismatch raised an exception, suppressing compensation as unknown inspection.
Interface proof collapsed incomplete execution and genuine mismatch; live verification now must preserve that distinction.
No independent completed-update observation window in the current host state machine.
No automatic causal durable repair intake from exact update failure evidence.
External services, host tools and schema/data upgrades lack their own proven update/restore adapters.

implementationThisTurn.behavior: Explicit false verdict for completed valid output mismatch; timeout/truncation/nonzero/invalid JSON/identity errors remain unknown. Existing updater owns single compensation and fresh authorization.

nextImplementationWithinExistingRoute.details: Versioned descriptors bind actual installed identity, official sources, dependency group, fixed build adapter, immutable independent interface criteria, data/permissions boundary and exact restore adapter. Model text cannot add privileges.
Use existing host controller lifecycle and durable update job. Read behavior, not container health alone. Deterministic recovery must work while the model is unavailable.

Retained release/behavior/rollback receipts create or update one source-bound repair goal after the good baseline is restored. Eva authors adaptation; independent criteria stay separate; a changed candidate must be reviewed before any bounded reattempt.
Prove another real update or failure through the same route without a new manual host handoff, preserving original E4.16 criteria.

dataRecoveryRule: Image rollback does not reverse a data/schema migration. Require a separately proven backwards-compatible migration/restore strategy before admission; never erase new user records by restoring an old data snapshot.
